Author: Ajay Bhanot

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 76
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 21298 of 2023
Applicant :- Amit Katiyar And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Shravan Kumar Pandey,Shyam Narain Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Pramod Kumar Singh
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Heard Shri Shravan Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicants and learned Aga for the
State.
Shri Shravan Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicants submits that the criminal proceedings are fall out of a matrimonial dispute between the parties.
The F.I.R. is actuated by malice and is being leveraged in a property dispute.
Criminal proceedings have been lodged at the instigation of vested interests.
The well wishers of the family members have intervened and are seeking to reconcile the parties.
There is still hope for reconciliation and amicable resolution of the dispute through mediation.
Permitting the learned trial court to proceed with the trial at this stage would aggravate the bad blood between the parties.
The breach could well become beyond recall.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The parties will attempt a reconciliation with the assistance of the Allahabad High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre,
Allahabad.
The following directions shall be executed by the respective parties:
1. The applicant is directed to deposit a sum of Rs.25,000/- before the Allahabad High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre, Allahabad within a period of one month from today.

shall be retained by the Allahabad High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre,
Allahabad.

3. The Allahabad High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre,Allahabad, shall fix the first date for mediation in the month of August, 2023 and issue notices to the parties accordingly.
4. The proceedings shall be concluded within a further period of four months from the date of initiation of the mediation proceedings in August, 2023.
Issue notice to opposite party no. 2.
Learned AGA to file counter affidavit within four weeks.
